```diff
+ /**

+  * @param program The Commander program instance
+  */
+ export default function registerImportCommands(program: Command): void {
+ 	// Main import command with interactive workflow
+ 	program
+ 		.command("import")
+ 		.description("Interactive data import workflow")
+ 		.action(async () =&gt; {
+ 			const choices = [

+ 					name: "Prepare events data (merge and validate)",

+ 				{
+ 					name: "Test events import (validate against database schema)",

+ 				},
+ 				{ name: "Import events data to Xata", value: "import-events" },

+ 					name: "Full workflow (prepare -&gt; test -&gt; import)",
+ 					value: "full-workflow",
+ 				},
+ 				{ name: "Import UFO Sightings data", value: "import-sightings" },
+ 				{ name: "Back", value: "back" },
+ 			];
+ 
+ 			const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([
+ 				{
+ 					type: "list",
+ 					name: "action",
+ 					message: "Select an import operation:",
+ 					choices,
+ 				},
+ 			]);
+ 
+ 			switch (action) {
+ 				case "prepare-events":
+ 					await prepareEventsData();
+ 					break;
+ 				case "test-events":
+ 					await testEventsImport();
+ 					break;
+ 				case "import-events":
+ 					await importEventsData();
+ 					break;
+ 				case "full-workflow":
+ 					await runFullWorkflow();
+ 					break;
+ 				case "import-sightings":
+ 					await importSightingsData();
+ 					break;
+ 				case "back":
+ 					console.log(chalk.blue("Returning to main menu"));
+ 					break;
+ 			}
+ 		});
+ 
+ 	// Direct command for preparing events data
+ 	program
+ 		.command("import:prepare-events")
+ 		.description("Prepare events data by merging and validating")
+ 		.action(async () =&gt; {
+ 			await prepareEventsData();
+ 		});
+ 
+ 	// Direct command for testing events import

+ 		});
+ }

+ 		}
```

```diff
- ## 3. Core Concepts &amp; Functionality
- 
- ### Buckets
- 
- - **Processing Bucket**: A folder (e.g., /data/processing) where new/unprocessed data files reside.
- - **Insertion Bucket**: A folder (e.g., /data/insertion) where files approved after review are moved. These files are "ready to roll" for insertion into Xata.
- 
- ### Metadata
- 
- Each file that lands in the insertion bucket will be accompanied by a metadata JSON containing:
- 
- - **Data schema**: For example, the JSON schema or CSV structure.
- - **Record count**: The number of records contained.
- - **Target Xata table**: Which table in Xata should receive the data.
- - **Processing date/timestamp**: When the file was processed.
- - **Quality score**: Based on validation rules (from existing code).
- - **Data type**: What kind of data (testimonies, events, etc.).
- 
- ### Workflow Phases
- 
- 1. **Processing Phase**:
-    - List &amp; Select Files: Interactive command to show files in the processing bucket.
-    - Transformation: Run transformations on the selected files.
-    - AI Enhancement: Use the AI assistant to suggest improvements.
- 
- 2. **Review Phase**:
-    - Preview Transformed Data: Show sample data and metadata.
-    - Quality Assessment: Display validation results and quality score.
-    - Approval Process: Move approved files to the insertion bucket.
- 
- 3. **Insertion Phase**:
-    - Metadata Display: Show file metadata before insertion.
-    - Insertion Options: Choose batch or bulk insertion.
-    - Robust Insertion: Handle errors and ensure data integrity.
- 
- ## 4. Data Type Support
- 
- The CLI will support multiple data types, leveraging existing processing logic:
- 
- 1. **Testimonies**:
-    - Parse testimony summaries from Markdown files
-    - Extract structured data (personnel, events, etc.)
-    - Connect to related database tables
- 
- 2. **Events**:
-    - Process event data from various sources
-    - Handle geocoding and location data
-    - Manage related metadata
- 
- 3. **Personnel**:
-    - Process biographical information
-    - Handle authority metrics and rankings
-    - Manage relationships to other entities
- 
- 4. **Organizations**:
-    - Process organization data
-    - Manage relationships to personnel and events
- 
- 5. **Extensibility**:
-    - Design for easy addition of new data types
-    - Create consistent interfaces across types
- 
- ## 5. Implementation Details
- 
- ### Command Structure
- 
- The CLI will implement these specific commands:
- 
- #### Processing Commands
+ ## 2. Command Structure
+ 
+ The CLI implements these specific commands:
+ 
+ ### Processing Commands
  
  &#96;&#96;&#96;
  process:list              List all files in the processing bucket
  process:transform &lt;file&gt;  Transform a file using predefined transformations
  process:enhance &lt;file&gt;    Apply AI-powered data enhancements
- 
- AI Assistant Integration
- 
- Integrate a module (e.g., aiAssistant.js) that:
-  • Accepts a file or data preview.
-  • Suggests data quality improvements or extraction tweaks.
-  • Can optionally run corrections if the user approves.
- Think of it as having an AI sidekick that points out “Hey, you missed that column!” with flair.
- 
- ⸻
- 
- 3. CLI Application Command Design using Commander
- 
- Overall CLI App Structure
- 
- Your main entry point (e.g., bin/cli.js) sets up Commander with subcommands or a hierarchical command structure like:
- 
- # !/usr/bin/env node
- 
- const { program } = require('commander');
- 
- // Import commands modules
- const processingCmd = require('../src/commands/processing');
- const reviewCmd = require('../src/commands/review');
- const insertionCmd = require('../src/commands/insertion');
- 
- program
-   .name('data-processing-cli')
-   .description('CLI tool for processing and inserting UFO data into Xata')
-   .version('1.0.0');
- 
- // Register subcommands
- processingCmd(program);
- reviewCmd(program);
- insertionCmd(program);
- 
- program.parse(process.argv);
- 
- Subcommand Examples
- 
-  1. Processing Commands
-  • process:list – Lists all files in the processing bucket.
-  • process:transform &lt;file&gt; – Runs a transformation on the selected file.
-  • process:enhance &lt;file&gt; – Optionally run the AI assistant to analyze/enhance the file.
-  2. Review Commands
-  • review:list – Lists files ready for review.
-  • review:preview &lt;file&gt; – Displays a preview.
-  • review:approve &lt;file&gt; – Moves the file to the insertion bucket along with creating/updating the metadata.
-  • review:reject &lt;file&gt; – Option to reject file processing.
-  3. Insertion Commands
-  • insert:list – View files in the insertion bucket with metadata summary.
-  • insert:batch &lt;file&gt; [options] – Perform batch insertion with options for batch interval, preview step, etc.
-  • insert:bulk &lt;file&gt; – Perform bulk insertion into the specified Xata table.
- 
- Note: Use inquirer to provide interactive menus. For instance, when listing files, present checkboxes or lists for file selection.
- 
- ⸻
- 
- 4. Component-Level Detail
- 
- 4.1. File Management (fileManager.js)
-  • Responsibility:
-  • Scanning directories (processing vs. insertion).
-  • Moving files (after review, move from processing to insertion).
-  • Reading and writing metadata alongside each file.
-  • Implementation Ideas:
-  • Use Node’s fs module along with path for robust file operations.
-  • Implement helper methods like listFiles(directory), moveFile(src, dest), and readMetadata(file).
- 
- 4.2. Metadata Module (metadata.js)
-  • Responsibility:
-  • Create metadata based on file content (e.g., record count via stream parsing).
-  • Store metadata in either a sidecar JSON file or as part of the file header.
-  • Implementation Ideas:
-  • Define a metadata schema using JSON Schema or even with zod for runtime validation.
-  • For example, metadata might include fields like: schema: {...}, recordCount: 123, targetTable: "ufo_events".
- 
- 4.3. Xata Insertion Client (xataClient.js)
-  • Responsibility:
-  • Abstract the logic to connect to the Xata API.
-  • Handle both batch and bulk insertions.
-  • Implementation Ideas:
-  • Use a generic function such as insertRecords(tableName, records, options) that wraps error handling, retries, and logging.
-  • Validate the target table and ensure the column structure is as expected.
- 
- 4.4. AI Integration Module (aiAssistant.js)
-  • Responsibility:
-  • Integrate with an LLM (for example, using the OpenAI API or similar) to provide data quality insights.
-  • Implementation Ideas:
-  • Expose functions like suggestEnhancements(fileData) that return suggestions.
-  • Optionally allow a “fix” command that automatically applies some transformations.
- 
- ⸻
- 
- 5. Interactive Workflow &amp; User Experience
- 
- Step-by-Step User Flow
- 
-  1. User runs CLI entry point:
- The Commander framework boots up, showing the main menu with options like “Processing,” “Review,” and “Insertion.”
-  2. Processing Phase:
-  • List Files: User runs process:list to see available files.
-  • Transform/Enhance: User selects a file and runs process:transform or process:enhance (invoking AI assistance if desired).
-  • File moves to temporary “pending review” state.
-  3. Review Phase:
-  • Preview Data: With review:preview &lt;file&gt;, the CLI shows a data sample and metadata.
- A quick note: “This file just came in hotter than a UFO sighting on a summer night!”
-  • Approve/Reject: Use review:approve to move the file to the insertion bucket (which also writes metadata) or reject it for further manual adjustments.
-  4. Insertion Phase:
-  • Metadata Summary: insert:list shows all files with metadata such as schema, record count, and target table.
-  • Choose Insertion Option: User decides whether to perform batch insertion (with a guided interactive menu that periodically reviews the data on completion of each batch) or a bulk insert.
-  • Insertion Execution: The CLI then executes the insertion logic via the xataClient integration, handling errors with options for retry or skipping.
- 
- ⸻
- 
- 6. Example Pseudocode Snippets
- 
- A. Commander Command Registration (processing.js)

- 7. Wrapping Up and Scalability Considerations
-  • Error Handling &amp; Logging:
- Use packages like ora for spinner-based status updates and chalk for clear terminal outputs. Ensure each command catches errors and provides user options to retry or skip.
-  • Plugin Architecture (Future-proofing):
- Consider structuring your CLI so that future functionalities (like new AI models or additional data sources) can be plugged in with minimal changes.
-  • Testing &amp; Validation:
- Integrate automated tests (e.g., with Mocha or Jest) for your file operations, metadata validations, and API interactions with Xata to ensure robustness as data scales.
-  • User Experience:
- A clean, intuitive interactive menu (via inquirer) alongside clear documentation will be critical. Since you’re developing an internal tool, lean into your inside jokes (about aliens and UFOs) to keep the mood light—even if the data is out of this world.
- 
- ⸻
- 
- This design gives you a modular, scalable, and interactive CLI application built with Commander. It mirrors the functionality intended by your run-import.sh script while extending it with robust interactive capabilities and AI-powered enhancements. Happy coding—and may your data always be as reliable as a well-timed UFO sighting!
- 
- /cli/
- ├── bin/
- │   └── cli.js                   # Entry point for your CLI app
- ├── src/
- │   ├── commands/                # All Commander command implementations
- │   │   ├── processing.js        # Processing bucket commands
- │   │   ├── review.js            # Review phase commands
- │   │   └── insertion.js         # Insertion bucket &amp; Xata integration commands
- │   ├── lib/
- │   │   ├── fileManager.js       # File operations, directory scanning, file moving
- │   │   ├── metadata.js          # Handling metadata for each insertion file
- │   │   ├── xataClient.js        # Xata client wrapper that abstracts insertion logic
- │   │   └── aiAssistant.js       # Integration with an LLM for data enhancements
- │   └── config.js                # Central config, such as bucket paths, API keys, etc.
- ├── package.json                 # Dependencies, scripts (commander, inquirer, ora, chalk, etc.)
- └── README.md
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Review Commands
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ review:list               Lists files ready for review
+ review:preview &lt;file&gt;     Displays a preview
+ review:approve &lt;file&gt;     Moves the file to the insertion bucket along with metadata
+ review:reject &lt;file&gt;      Option to reject file processing
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Import Commands
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ import                    Interactive data import workflow menu
+ import:prepare-events     Prepare events data by merging and validating
+ import:test-events        Test events import by validating against database schema
+ import:events             Import events data to Xata (with --force and --update options)
+ import:sightings          Import UFO Sightings data
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Insertion Commands
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ insert:list               View files in the insertion bucket with metadata summary
+ insert:batch &lt;file&gt;       Perform batch insertion with options
+ insert:bulk &lt;file&gt;        Perform bulk insertion into the specified Xata table
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 3. Getting Started
+ 
+ ### Installation
+ 
+ Clone the repository and install dependencies:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Navigate to the CLI directory
+ cd cli
+ 
+ # Install dependencies
+ npm install
+ 
+ # Build the CLI
+ npm run build
+ 
+ # Link the CLI globally (optional)
+ npm link
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Usage
+ 
+ Run the CLI with:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # Using the npm script
+ npm run start
+ 
+ # Or if globally linked
+ ut-cli
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 4. Workflow
+ 
+ The typical data processing workflow is:
+ 
+ 1. **Discover** - Find and import new files into the system
+ 2. **Process** - Transform and prepare files for review
+ 3. **Review** - Validate and approve processed files
+ 4. **Import** - Run specific import workflows for events and sightings
+ 5. **Insert** - Insert approved data into the Xata database
+ 
+ ## 5. Development
+ 
+ ### Adding a New Command
+ 
+ To add a new command, create a file in the appropriate directory under &#96;src/commands/&#96; and implement the command following the pattern of existing commands.
+ 
+ ### Running in Development Mode
+ 
+ To run the CLI in development mode:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run dev
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 6. Future Enhancements
+ 
+ - Add more data types (testimonies, personnel, organizations, etc.)
+ - Implement batch processing for large datasets
+ - Add visualization tools for data quality assessment
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * Import data to a specific Xata table
+  */
+ async function importToTable(table: string, options: any): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {
+ 	console.log(chalk.blue(&#96;=== Importing Data to Xata Table: ${table} ===&#96;));
+ 
+ 	// Check if file exists
+ 	const filePath = path.resolve(options.file);
+ 	if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) {
+ 		console.log(chalk.red(&#96;Error: File not found at ${filePath}&#96;));
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Read file contents
+ 	const spinner = ora(
+ 		&#96;Reading data from ${path.basename(filePath)}...&#96;,
+ 	).start();
+ 	let data;
+ 	try {
+ 		const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, "utf8");
+ 		data = JSON.parse(fileContent);
+ 
+ 		if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
+ 			spinner.fail("Error: File must contain a JSON array of objects");
+ 			return false;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		spinner.succeed(&#96;Successfully read ${data.length} records from file&#96;);
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		spinner.fail(&#96;Error reading or parsing file: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Display sample data and confirmation
+ 	console.log(chalk.blue("\nData Sample (first 2 records):"));
+ 	console.log(JSON.stringify(data.slice(0, 2), null, 2));
+ 
+ 	// If it's a dry run, exit here
+ 	if (options.dryRun) {
+ 		console.log(chalk.yellow("\nDry run completed. No data was imported."));
+ 		return true;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Confirm import

+ 
+ async function importData() {
+ 	console.log(\&#96;Starting import of \${data.length} records to table: ${table}\&#96;);
+ 	
+ 	// Track progress
+ 	let imported = 0;
+ 	let failed = 0;
+ 	let skipped = 0;
+ 	const errors = [];
+ 	
+ 	// Process in batches
+ 	const batchSize = ${batchSize};
+ 	const batches = Math.ceil(data.length / batchSize);
+ 	
+ 	for (let i = 0; i &lt; batches; i++) {
+ 		const start = i * batchSize;
+ 		const end = Math.min(start + batchSize, data.length);
+ 		const batch = data.slice(start, end);
+ 		
+ 		console.log(\&#96;Processing batch \${i + 1}/\${batches} (\${batch.length} records)\&#96;);
+ 		
+ 		try {
+ 			// Use bulk insert or transaction based on options
+ 			const options = {
+ 				${options.force ? 'ifExists: "create",' : ""}
+ 				${options.update ? 'ifExists: "update",' : ""}
+ 			};
+ 			
+ 			const result = await xata.db.${table}.bulkCreate(batch, options);
+ 			
+ 			// Process results
+ 			imported += result.filter(r =&gt; r.operation === "insert" || r.operation === "update").length;
+ 			skipped += result.filter(r =&gt; r.operation === "skip").length;
+ 			
+ 			// Log errors
+ 			const batchErrors = result.filter(r =&gt; r.error);
+ 			if (batchErrors.length &gt; 0) {
+ 				failed += batchErrors.length;
+ 				for (const item of batchErrors) {
+ 					errors.push({
+ 						record: item.record,
+ 						error: item.error
+ 					});
+ 				}
+ 			}
+ 		} catch (error) {
+ 			console.error(\&#96;Error processing batch \${i + 1}: \${error.message}\&#96;);
+ 			failed += batch.length;
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 	
+ 	// Print final results
+ 	console.log("\\n=== Import Results ===");
+ 	console.log(\&#96;Total Records: \${data.length}\&#96;);
+ 	console.log(\&#96;Imported: \${imported}\&#96;);
+ 	console.log(\&#96;Skipped: \${skipped}\&#96;);
+ 	console.log(\&#96;Failed: \${failed}\&#96;);
+ 	
+ 	// Save errors to file if any
+ 	if (errors.length &gt; 0) {
+ 		const fs = require('fs');
+ 		const errorFile = 'import-errors.json';
+ 		fs.writeFileSync(errorFile, JSON.stringify(errors, null, 2));
+ 		console.log(\&#96;\\nErrors saved to: \${errorFile}\&#96;);
+ 	}
+ 	
+ 	return {
+ 		total: data.length,
+ 		imported,
+ 		skipped,
+ 		failed
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ // Run the import
+ importData()
+ 	.then(results =&gt; {
+ 		console.log("\\nImport completed successfully");
+ 		process.exit(0);
+ 	})
+ 	.catch(error =&gt; {
+ 		console.error(\&#96;Import failed: \${error.message}\&#96;);
+ 		process.exit(1);
+ 	});
+ &#96;;
+ 
+ 		fs.writeFileSync(tempScriptPath, scriptContent);
+ 
+ 		// Execute the script
+ 		const cmdArgs = [];
+ 		if (options.force) cmdArgs.push("--force");
+ 		if (options.update) cmdArgs.push("--update");
+ 
+ 		await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} &amp;&amp; bun run ${tempScriptPath}&#96;);
+ 
+ 		importSpinner.succeed("Import process completed");
+ 		return true;
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		importSpinner.fail(&#96;Error importing data: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);
+ 		return false;
+ 	}
+ }
```

```diff
  &#96;&#96;&#96;
  
- ## 6. Future Enhancements
+ ## 6. Custom Table Import
+ 
+ The CLI provides a flexible way to import data into any Xata table using the &#96;import:table&#96; command. This is useful for one-off imports or for importing data into tables that don't have specific import workflows.
+ 
+ ### Usage
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ ut-cli import:table &lt;table-name&gt; -f &lt;file-path&gt; [options]
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Options
+ 
+ - &#96;-f, --file &lt;path&gt;&#96;: (Required) Path to the JSON file containing the data to import
+ - &#96;-d, --dry-run&#96;: Validate the data without performing the actual import
+ - &#96;--force&#96;: Force import even if duplicates are detected
+ - &#96;--update&#96;: Update existing records if duplicates are found
+ - &#96;--batch-size &lt;size&gt;&#96;: Number of records to insert in each batch (default: 50)
+ 
+ ### Example
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ ut-cli import:table ufo_reports -f ./data/reports.json --update --batch-size 100
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### JSON Format
+ 
+ The input JSON file should contain an array of objects, where each object represents a record to be inserted into the table:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;json
+ [
+   {
+     "field1": "value1",
+     "field2": "value2",
+     ...
+   },
+   {
+     "field1": "value3",
+     "field2": "value4",
+     ...
+   }
+ ]
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 7. Future Enhancements
  
  - Add more data types (testimonies, personnel, organizations, etc.)
```

```json
        "originalContents": "\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // src/lib/xataClient.ts\n   import { getXataClient } from '../../src/db/xata/xata';\n   \n   export async function insertRecords(tableName: string, records: any[], options = {}) {\n     const xata = getXataClient();\n     \n     try {\n       // Handle batching for large datasets\n       const batchSize = options.batchSize || 100;\n       \n       // Process in batches\n       for (let i = 0; i \u003c records.length; i += batchSize) {\n         const batch = records.slice(i, i + batchSize);\n         \n         // Use transaction for batch operations\n         await xata.db[tableName].create(batch);\n       }\n       \n       return { success: true, count: records.length };\n     } catch (error) {\n       return { success: false, error: error.message, failedAt: records.indexOf(error.record) };\n     }\n   }\n   \n   export async function checkDuplicates(tableName: string, records: any[], options = {}) {\n     // Implementation...\n   }\n   \n   // Additional Xata operations...\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Import Integration**\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n   // src/commands/import.ts\n   // Adaptation of run-import.sh functionality as a command module\n   export default function registerImportCommands(program: Command): void {\n     // Implementation...\n   }\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Command Structure Overview\n\nThe CLI will provide these primary command categories:\n\n1. **Discovery \u0026 Onboarding**\n   - &#96;onboard&#96; - Discover and move new datasets to the processing bucket\n   - &#96;status&#96; - Show the status of all buckets and files\n\n2. **Processing Commands**\n   - &#96;process:list&#96; - List all files in processing buckets\n   - &#96;process:\u003cmodel\u003e&#96; - Process files for a specific model\n   - &#96;process:transform \u003cfile\u003e&#96; - Transform a specific file\n   - &#96;process:validate \u003cfile\u003e&#96; - Validate a file against its schema\n\n",

.description('Interactive data import workflow')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      const choices = [\n        { name: 'Prepare events data (merge and validate)', value: 'prepare-events' },\n        { name: 'Test events import (validate against database schema)', value: 'test-events' },\n        { name: 'Import events data to Xata', value: 'import-events' },\n        { name: 'Full workflow const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'list',\n          name: 'action',\n          message: 'Select an import operation:',\n          choices\n        }\n      ]);\n\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'prepare-events':\n          await prepareEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'test-events':\n          await testEventsImport();\n          break;\n        case 'import-events':\n          await importEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'full-workflow':\n          await runFullWorkflow();\n          break;\n        case });\n\n  // Direct command for preparing events data\n  program\n    .command('import:prepare-events')\n    .description('Prepare events data by merging and validating')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await prepareEventsData();\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for testing events import\n  program\n    .command('import:test-events')\n    .description('Test events import by validating against         "originalContents": "export default function registerImportCommands(program: Command): void {\n  // Main import command with interactive workflow\n  program\n    .command('import')\n   { name: 'Test events import (validate against database schema)', value: 'test-events' },\n        { name: 'Import events data to Xata', value: 'import-events' },\n        { name: 'Full workflow const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'list',\n          name: 'action',\n          message: 'Select an import operation:',\n          choices\n        }\n      ]);\n\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'prepare-events':\n          await prepareEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'test-events':\n          await testEventsImport();\n          break;\n        case 'import-events':\n          await importEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'full-workflow':\n          await runFullWorkflow();\n          break;\n        case 'import-sightings':\n          await importSightingsData();\n          break;\n        case 'back':\n          console.log(chalk.blue('Returning to main menu'));\n          break;\n      }\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for preparing events data\n  program\n    .command('import:prepare-events')\n    .description('Prepare events data by merging and validating')\n    .action(async () =\u003e         "originalContents": "  try {\n    // Run TypeScript import script with Bun\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 bun run ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/import-events-to-xata.ts')} ${args.join(' ')}&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Events import process complete');\n    \n    // Check if skipped events report exists\n    const skippedEventsReportPath = path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/skipped-events-report.json');\n    if (fs.existsSync(skippedEventsReportPath)) {\n      console.log(chalk.yellow(&#96;Skipped events report available at: ${skippedEventsReportPath}&#96;));\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to import events data to Xata: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Import sightings data\n */\nasync function importSightingsData(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== UFO Sightings Data Import ==='));\n  \n  // Check if sightings data exists\n  const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n  const sightingsFile = path.join(projectDir, 'output/transformed-sightings.json');\n  \n  if (!fs.existsSync(sightingsFile)) {\n    console.log(chalk.red(&#96;Error: Sightings data file not found at ${sightingsFile}&#96;));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 1: Sightings data found.'));\n  console.log(chalk.blue(&#96;  - JSON data: ${sightingsFile}&#96;));\n  \n  const { reviewData } = await inquirer.prompt([\n    {\n      type: 'confirm',\n      name: 'reviewData',\n      message: 'Would you like to review the sightings data before importing to Xata?',\n      default: false\n    }\n  ]);\n  \n",

        "contents": "async function importEventsData(force: boolean = false, update: boolean = false): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== UFO Intelligence Data Import ==='));\n  \n  // Check if events.json exists\n  const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n  const dataImportDir = path.join(projectDir, 'scripts/data-import');\n  const eventsJsonPath = path.join(dataImportDir, 'output/events.json');\n  \n  if (!fs.existsSync(eventsJsonPath)) {\n    console.log(chalk.red('Error: events.json not found. Please prepare the data first.'));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 1: Validating events data...'));\n  \n  // Run validation/test first\n  const validationResult = await testEventsImport();\n  \n  if (!validationResult) {\n    console.log(chalk.red('Validation failed. Fix issues before proceeding.'));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  // If force and update are not set via flags, prompt for them\n  if (!force || !update) {\n    const answers = await inquirer.prompt([\n      {\n        type: 'confirm',\n        name: 'confirmImport',\n        message: 'Would you like to proceed with the import?',\n        default: true\n      }\n    ]);\n    \n    if (!answers.confirmImport) {\n      console.log(chalk.yellow('Import cancelled.'));\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (!force) {\n      const { forceOption } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'confirm',\n          name: 'forceOption',\n          message: 'Force import even if duplicates are detected?',\n          default: false\n        }\n      ]);\n      force = forceOption;\n    }\n    \n    if (!update) {\n      const { updateOption } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'confirm',\n          name: 'updateOption',\n          message: 'Update existing records if duplicates are found?',\n          default: false\n        }\n      ]);\n      update = updateOption;\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Build command arguments\n  const args = [];\n  if (force) args.push('--force');\n  if (update) args.push('--update');\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 3: Importing events data to Xata database...'));\n  \n  const spinner = ora('Running TypeScript import script...').start();\n  \n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  if (reviewData) {\n    // Show a sample of the data\n    const spinner = ora('Loading data sample...').start();\n    try {\n      const { stdout } = await execAsync(&#96;head -n 30 \"${sightingsFile}\"&#96;);\n      spinner.stop();\n      \n      console.log(chalk.blue('\\nSample of sightings data (first 3 sightings):'));\n      console.log(stdout);\n      \n      await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'input',\n          name: 'continue',\n          message: 'Press Enter to continue with import or Ctrl+C to abort...'\n        }\n      ]);\n    } catch (error) {\n      spinner.fail(&#96;Error reading data sample: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('\\nStep 2: Importing sightings data to Xata database...'));\n  \n  const spinner = ora('Running import script...').start();\n  \n  try {\n    // Use npm script to run TypeScript import script\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 npm run import:sightings&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Sightings import process complete');\n    console.log(chalk.green('Check the logs above for details on imported, skipped, and failed entries.'));\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to import sightings data to Xata: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Run full workflow: prepare -\u003e test -\u003e import\n */\nasync function runFullWorkflow(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== Running Full Events Import Workflow ==='));\n  \n  // Step 1: Prepare events data\n  const prepareResult = await prepareEventsData();\n  if (!prepareResult) {\n    console.log(chalk.red('Preparation step failed. Workflow aborted.'));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  // Step 2: Test events import\n  const testResult = await testEventsImport();\n  if (!testResult) {\n    console.log(chalk.red('Testing step failed. Workflow aborted.'));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  // Step 3: Import events data\n  return await importEventsData();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Benefits of This Approach\n\n1. **Modular Design**: Adds import functionality while maintaining consistency with the existing CLI architecture\n\n2. **Interactive \u0026 Direct Access**: Supports both menu-based workflows and direct command execution\n\n3. **Maintained Functionality**: Preserves all the functionality of the original bash script\n\n4. **Type Safety**: Leverages TypeScript for improved code quality and maintainability\n\n5. **Enhanced UX**: Uses ora spinners, chalk colors, and inquirer prompts for a better user experience\n\n## Next Steps\n\n1.         "contents": "\n\n// Parse command line arguments\nconst args = process.argv.slice(2);\nconst forceImport = args.includes('--force') || args.includes('-f');\nconst minQualityScore = args.includes('--min-quality') ? \n  parseInt(args[args.indexOf('--min-quality') + 1] || '50', 10) : 50;\nconst updateExisting = args.includes('--update') || args.includes('-u');\nconst skipDuplicates = !args.includes('--no-skip-duplicates');\n\n// Display help if requested\nif (args.includes('--help') || args.includes('-h')) {\n  console.log(&#96;\nUsage: npm run import-testimonies [options]\n\nOptions:\n  --force, -f                 Force import even if duplicates are detected\n  --min-quality \u003cscore\u003e       Set minimum quality threshold (default: 50)\n  --update, -u                Update existing records if duplicates are found\n  --no-skip-duplicates        Check duplicates but import anyway\n  --help, -h                  Show this help message\n&#96;);\n  process.exit(0);\n}\n\n// Run the import with options\nimportTestimoniesToXata({ \n  forceImport,\n  minQualityScore,\n  skipDuplicates,\n  updateExisting\n})\n  .then(() =\u003e console.log('Import completed successfully'))\n  .catch(err =\u003e {\n    console.error('Import failed:', err);\n    process.exit(1);\n  });",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Parse command line arguments\nconst args = process.argv.slice(2);\nconst forceImport = args.includes('--force') || args.includes('-f');\nconst minQualityScore = args.includes('--min-quality') ? \n  parseInt(args[args.indexOf('--min-quality') + 1] || '50', 10) : 50;\nconst updateExisting = args.includes('--update') || args.includes('-u');\nconst skipDuplicates = !args.includes('--no-skip-duplicates');\n\n// Display help if requested\nif (args.includes('--help') || args.includes('-h')) {\n  console.log(&#96;\nUsage: npm run import-testimonies [options]\n\nOptions:\n  --force, -f                 Force import even if duplicates are detected\n  --min-quality \u003cscore\u003e       Set minimum quality threshold (default: 50)\n  --update, -u                Update existing records if duplicates are found\n  --no-skip-duplicates        Check duplicates but import anyway\n  --help, -h                  Show this help message\n&#96;);\n  process.exit(0);\n}\n\n// Run the import with options\nimportTestimoniesToXata({ \n  forceImport,\n  minQualityScore,\n  skipDuplicates,\n  updateExisting\n})\n  .then(() =\u003e console.log('Import completed successfully'))\n  .catch(err =\u003e {\n    console.error('Import failed:', err);\n    process.exit(1);\n  });",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Xata API configuration\n */\nconst xataConfig = {\n  apiKey: process.env.XATA_API_KEY || '',\n  databaseURL: process.env.XATA_DATABASE_URL || 'https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial',\n  branch: process.env.XATA_BRANCH || 'main',\n};\n\n/**\n * AI assistant configuration\n */\nconst aiConfig = {\n  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || '',\n  model: process.env.AI_MODEL || 'gpt-4',\n  endpoint: process.env.AI_ENDPOINT || 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',\n  maxTokens: parseInt(process.env.AI_MAX_TOKENS || '1000', 10),\n};\n\n/**\n * CLI settings\n */\nconst cliConfig = {\n  defaultQualityThreshold: 50, // Default data quality score threshold (0-100)\n  batchSize: 100, // Default batch size for insertions\n  logLevel: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',\n};\n\n// Check if Xata API key is set\nif (!xataConfig.apiKey) {\n  console.warn('⚠️  Warning: XATA_API_KEY environment variable is not set.       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Bulk insert a file into Xata\n * @param dataType Data type\n * @param fileName File name\n * @param options Insertion options\n * @returns Promise that resolves when insertion is complete\n */\nasync function bulkInsertFile(\n  dataType: keyof DataTypeConfig, \n  fileName: string, \n  options: { \n    force?: boolean,\n    update?: boolean\n  }\n): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  const spinner = ora(&#96;Bulk inserting ${fileName}...&#96;).start();\n  \n  try {\n    // Read file content\n    const content = await fileManager.readFile(dataType, 'insertion', fileName);\n    \n    // Read metadata\n    const metadata = await readMetadata(dataType, 'insertion', fileName);\n    \n    // Parse content based on file type\n    let records: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (fileName.endsWith('.json')) {\n      // Parse JSON file\n      records = JSON.parse(content);\n      if (!Array.isArray(records)) {\n        // If the JSON is an object, not an array, convert it to an array\n        records = [records];\n      }\n    } else if (fileName.endsWith('.md') || fileName.endsWith('.txt')) {\n      // For markdown or text files, we might need more complex parsing\n      // For now, just create a single record with the content\n      records = [{\n        title: fileName.replace(/\\.[^/.]+$/, \"\"),\n        content: content,\n        summary: metadata.summary || content.substring(0, 200)\n      }];\n    } else {\n      // Unsupported file type\n      spinner.fail(&#96;Unsupported file type for ${fileName}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    // Update status\n    spinner.text = &#96;Bulk inserting ${fileName} (${records.length} records)...&#96;;\n    \n    // Target table from metadata\n    const targetTable = metadata.targetTable || dataType;",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Bulk insert a file into Xata\n * @param dataType Data type\n * @param fileName File name\n * @param options Insertion options\n * @returns Promise that resolves when insertion is complete\n */\nasync function bulkInsertFile(\n  dataType: keyof DataTypeConfig, \n  fileName: string, \n  options: { \n    force?: boolean,\n    update?: boolean\n  }\n): Promise\u003cvoid\u003e {\n  const spinner = ora(&#96;Bulk inserting ${fileName}...&#96;).start();\n  \n  try {\n    // Read file content\n    const content = await fileManager.readFile(dataType, 'insertion', fileName);\n    \n    // Read metadata\n    const metadata = await readMetadata(dataType, 'insertion', fileName);\n    \n    // Parse content based on file type\n    let records: any[] = [];\n    \n    if (fileName.endsWith('.json')) {\n      // Parse JSON file\n      records = JSON.parse(content);\n      if (!Array.isArray(records)) {\n        // If the JSON is an object, not an array, convert it to an array\n        records = [records];\n      }\n    } else if (fileName.endsWith('.md') || fileName.endsWith('.txt')) {\n      // For markdown or text files, we might need more complex parsing\n      // For now, just create a single record with the content\n      records = [{\n        title: fileName.replace(/\\.[^/.]+$/, \"\"),\n        content: content,\n        summary: metadata.summary || content.substring(0, 200)\n      }];\n    } else {\n      // Unsupported file type\n      spinner.fail(&#96;Unsupported file type for ${fileName}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    // Update status\n    spinner.text = &#96;Bulk inserting ${fileName} (${records.length} records)...&#96;;\n    \n    // Target table from metadata\n    const targetTable = metadata.targetTable || dataType;",
```

```json
        "contents": "# Ultraterrestrial CLI - Import Module Enhancement\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines a plan to enhance the Ultraterrestrial CLI by incorporating the functionality from the &#96;run-import.sh&#96; script into a dedicated TypeScript module. The goal is to maintain the interactive nature of the original script while integrating it with the modular CLI architecture.\n\n## Implementation Plan\n\n### 1. Create a New Command Module\n\nCreate a new file at &#96;src/commands/import.ts&#96; with the following structure:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { Command } from 'commander';\nimport chalk from 'chalk';\nimport * as inquirer from 'inquirer';\nimport ora from 'ora';\nimport * as path from 'path';\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport { exec } from 'child_process';\nimport { promisify } from 'util';\n\nconst execAsync = promisify(exec);\n\nexport default function registerImportCommands(program: Command): void {\n  // Command definitions go here\n}\n\n// Implementation functions go here\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Define Command Structure\n\nThe module will provide both an interactive menu-based approach and direct commands:\n\n- **Interactive Command**:\n  - &#96;import&#96; - Displays a menu of import options similar to run-import.sh\n\n- **Direct Commands**:\n  - &#96;import:prepare-events&#96; - Prepare events data\n  - &#96;import:test-events&#96; - Test events import\n  - &#96;import:events&#96; - Import events data to Xata (with --force and --update options)\n  - &#96;import:sightings&#96; - Import UFO Sightings data\n\n### 3. Core Functions to Implement\n\n1. **prepareEventsData()**\n   - Process and merge event JSON files\n   - Generate combined output file\n\n2. **testEventsImport()**\n   - Validate events data against schema\n   - Generate validation report\n\n3. **importEventsData()**\n   - Handle interactive prompts for confirmation\n   - Support force and update options\n   - Execute the import process\n\n4. **importSightingsData()**\n   - Verify sightings data exists\n   - Provide data preview option\n   - Execute the sightings import process\n\n",

        "contents": "# Ultraterrestrial Data Import CLI - Implementation Plan\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nThis document outlines the implementation plan for creating a modular, interactive CLI tool to manage the data processing and import workflow for the Ultraterrestrial project. The tool facilitates the movement of data through four distinct phases: Processing, Review, Import, and Insertion, with each phase having its own commands and operations.\n\n## 1. Overall Architecture \u0026 Directory Layout\n\nThe CLI follows a modular architecture with clear separation of concerns:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/cli/\n├── bin/\n│   └── cli.ts                   # Entry point for your CLI app\n├── src/\n│   ├── commands/                # All Commander command implementations\n│   │   ├── processing.ts        # Processing bucket commands\n│   │   ├── review.ts            # Review phase commands\n│   │   ├── import.ts            # Import workflow commands\n│   │   ├── insertion.ts         # Insertion bucket \u0026 Xata integration commands\n│   │   └── onboard.ts           # Onboarding and discovery commands\n│   ├── lib/\n│   │   ├── fileManager.ts       # File operations, directory scanning, file moving\n│   │   ├── metadata.ts          # Handling metadata for each insertion file\n│   │   ├── xataClient.ts        # Xata client wrapper that abstracts insertion logic\n│   │   └── aiAssistant.ts       # Integration with an LLM for data enhancements\n│   └── config.ts                # Central config, such as bucket paths, API keys, etc.\n├── package.json                 # Dependencies, scripts (commander, inquirer, ora, chalk, etc.)\n└── README.md\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 2. Command Structure\n\nThe CLI implements these specific commands:\n\n### Processing Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nprocess:list              List all files in the processing bucket\nprocess:transform \u003cfile\u003e  Transform a file using predefined transformations\nprocess:enhance \u003cfile\u003e    Apply AI-powered data enhancements\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# Ultraterrestrial CLI - Schema-Driven Data Processing Plan\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the enhanced approach for the Ultraterrestrial CLI, focusing on a schema-driven architecture that dynamically adapts to the Xata database model while enforcing strict data validation and fidelity. The CLI will implement a flexible bucket-based workflow for data processing, review, and insertion.\n\n## Core Architecture\n\n### 1. Schema-Driven Processing Architecture\n\nThe CLI will be designed around the Xata database schema, with the bucket system serving as the workflow mechanism:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nBacklog → Processing → Review → Insertion → Xata Database\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **Backlog**: Raw data files organized by model type (events/, personnel/, etc.)\n- **Processing**: Files being transformed and validated against schema\n- **Review**: Files that passed basic validation but need human review\n- **Insertion**: Files ready for database insertion\n\n### 2. Directory Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n/data/\n├── backlog/               # On-deck raw files waiting for processing\n│   ├── events/            # Raw event files\n│   ├── personnel/         # Raw personnel files\n│   └── ...                # Other model types from Xata schema\n├── processing/            # Files actively being processed\n│   ├── events/            # Events being validated/transformed\n│   └── ...\n├── review/                # Files that passed validation but need human review\n│   ├── events/\n│   └── ...\n└── insertion/             # Files ready for database insertion\n    ├── events/\n    └── ...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Key Components\n\n1. **Schema-Aware Model Registry**\n   - Loads and parses the Xata schema\n   - Extracts table definitions, required fields, and relationships\n   - Defines validation rules and transformations for each table\n\n",

        "contents": "  program\n    .command('import:events')\n    .description('Import events data to Xata')\n    .option('-f, --force', 'Force import even if duplicates are detected')\n    .option('-u, --update', 'Update existing records if duplicates are found')\n    .action(async (options) =\u003e {\n      await importEventsData(options.force, options.update);\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for importing sightings data\n  program\n    .command('import:sightings')\n    .description('Import UFO Sightings data')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await importSightingsData();\n    });\n}\n\n/**\n * Prepare events data\n */\nasync function prepareEventsData(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== Preparing Events Data ==='));\n  \n  const spinner = ora('Processing JSON event files...').start();\n  \n  try {\n    const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n    const dataImportDir = path.join(projectDir, 'scripts/data-import');\n    \n    // Execute the preparation script\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 bun run ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/prepare-events.ts')}&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Events preparation complete');\n    console.log(chalk.green(&#96;Combined events file saved to: ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'output/events.json')}&#96;));\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to prepare events data: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Test events import\n */\n",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Import command modules\ntry {\n\tconst registerProcessingCommands =\n\t\trequire(\"../src/commands/processing\").default;\n\tconst registerReviewCommands = require(\"../src/commands/review\").default;\n\tconst registerInsertionCommands =\n\t\trequire(\"../src/commands/insertion\").default;\n\tconst registerOnboardingCommands = require(\"../src/commands/onboard\").default;\n\tconst registerImportCommands = require(\"../src/commands/import\").default;\n\n\t// Register commands with the program\n\tregisterOnboardingCommands(program);\n\tregisterProcessingCommands(program);\n\tregisterReviewCommands(program);\n\tregisterInsertionCommands(program);\n\tregisterImportCommands(program);\n\n\t// If no arguments provided, show interactive menu\n\tif (process.argv.length === 2) {\n\t\tshowInteractiveMenu();\n\t} else {\n\t\t// Parse command line arguments\n\t\tprogram.parse(process.argv);\n\t}\n} catch (error) {\n\tconsole.error(chalk.red(\"Error initializing CLI commands:\"), error);\n\tprocess.exit(1);\n}\n\n// Handle unhandled promise rejections\nprocess.on(\"unhandledRejection\", (reason, promise) =\u003e {\n\tconsole.error(\n\t\tchalk.red(\"Unhandled Rejection at:\"),\n\t\tpromise,\n\t\tchalk.red(\"reason:\"),\n\t\treason,\n\t);\n\tprocess.exit(1);\n});",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Xata API configuration\n */\nconst xataConfig = {\n  apiKey: process.env.XATA_API_KEY || '',\n  databaseURL: process.env.XATA_DATABASE_URL || 'https://UltraTerrestrial-kgubvq.us-east-1.xata.sh/db/ultraterrestrial',\n  branch: process.env.XATA_BRANCH || 'main',\n};\n\n/**\n * AI assistant configuration\n */\nconst aiConfig = {\n  apiKey: process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || '',\n  model: process.env.AI_MODEL || 'gpt-4',\n  endpoint: process.env.AI_ENDPOINT || 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions',\n  maxTokens: parseInt(process.env.AI_MAX_TOKENS || '1000', 10),\n};\n\n/**\n * CLI settings\n */\nconst cliConfig = {\n  defaultQualityThreshold: 50, // Default data quality score threshold (0-100)\n  batchSize: 100, // Default batch size for insertions\n  logLevel: process.env.LOG_LEVEL || 'info',\n};\n\n// Check if Xata API key is set\nif (!xataConfig.apiKey) {\n  console.warn('⚠️  Warning: XATA_API_KEY environment variable is not set. Xata operations will fail.');\n}\n\n/**\n * Helper function to get bucket path for a specific data type and stage\n */\nfunction getBucketPath(dataType: keyof DataTypeConfig, stage: keyof BucketConfig): string {\n  if (!dataBuckets[dataType]) {\n    throw new Error(&#96;Unknown data type: ${dataType}&#96;);\n  }\n  if (!dataBuckets[dataType][stage]) {\n    throw new Error(&#96;Unknown stage: ${stage} for data type: ${dataType}&#96;);\n  }\n  return dataBuckets[dataType][stage];\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "program\n  .name('data-import-cli')\n  .description('CLI tool for processing and inserting UFO data into Xata')\n  .version('1.0.0');\n\n// Register subcommands\nprocessingCmd(program);\nreviewCmd(program);\ninsertionCmd(program);\n\nprogram.parse(process.argv);\n\nSubcommand Examples\n\t1.\tProcessing Commands\n\t•\tprocess:list – Lists all files in the processing bucket.\n\t•\tprocess:transform \u003cfile\u003e – Runs a transformation on the selected file.\n\t•\tprocess:enhance \u003cfile\u003e – Optionally run the AI assistant to analyze/enhance the file.\n\t2.\tReview Commands\n\t•\treview:list – Lists files ready for review.\n\t•\treview:preview \u003cfile\u003e – Displays a preview.\n\t•\treview:approve \u003cfile\u003e – Moves the file to the insertion bucket along with creating/updating the metadata.\n\t•\treview:reject \u003cfile\u003e – Option to reject file processing.\n\t3.\tInsertion Commands\n\t•\tinsert:list – View files in the insertion bucket with metadata summary.\n\t•\tinsert:batch \u003cfile\u003e [options] – Perform batch insertion with options for batch interval, preview step, etc.\n\t•\tinsert:bulk \u003cfile\u003e – Perform bulk insertion into the specified Xata table.\n\nNote: Use inquirer to provide interactive menus. For instance, when listing files, present checkboxes or lists for file selection.\n\n⸻\n\n4. Component-Level Detail\n\n4.1. File Management (fileManager.js)\n\t•\tResponsibility:\n\t•\tScanning directories (processing vs. insertion).\n\t•\tMoving files (after review, move from processing to insertion).\n\t•\tReading and writing metadata alongside each file.\n\t•\tImplementation Ideas:\n\t•\tUse Node’s fs module along with path for robust file operations.\n\t•\tImplement helper methods like listFiles(directory), moveFile(src, dest), and readMetadata(file).\n\n",

        "contents": "export default function registerImportCommands(program: Command): void {\n  // Main import command with interactive workflow\n  program\n    .command('import')\n    .description('Interactive data import workflow')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      const choices = [\n        { name: 'Prepare events data (merge and validate)', value: 'prepare-events' },\n        { name: 'Test events import (validate against database schema)', value: 'test-events' },\n        { name: 'Import events data to Xata', value: 'import-events' },\n        { name: 'Full workflow (prepare -\u003e test -\u003e import)', value: 'full-workflow' },\n        { name: 'Import UFO Sightings data', value: 'import-sightings' },\n        { name: 'Back', value: 'back' }\n      ];\n\n      const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'list',\n          name: 'action',\n          message: 'Select an import operation:',\n          choices\n        }\n      ]);\n\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'prepare-events':\n          await prepareEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'test-events':\n          await testEventsImport();\n          break;\n        case 'import-events':\n          await importEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'full-workflow':\n          await runFullWorkflow();\n          break;\n        case 'import-sightings':\n          await importSightingsData();\n          break;\n        case 'back':\n          console.log(chalk.blue('Returning to main menu'));\n          break;\n      }\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for preparing events data\n  program\n    .command('import:prepare-events')\n    .description('Prepare events data by merging and validating')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await prepareEventsData();\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for testing events import\n  program\n    .command('import:test-events')\n    .description('Test events import by validating against database schema')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await testEventsImport();\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for importing events data\n",

  { name: 'Test events import (validate against database schema)', value: 'test-events' },\n        { name: 'Import events data to Xata', value: 'import-events' },\n        { name: 'Full workflow const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'list',\n          name: 'action',\n          message: 'Select an import operation:',\n          choices\n        }\n      ]);\n\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'prepare-events':\n          await prepareEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'test-events':\n          await testEventsImport();\n          break;\n        case 'import-events':\n          await importEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'full-workflow':\n          await runFullWorkflow();\n          break;\n        case });\n\n  // Direct command for preparing events data\n  program\n    .command('import:prepare-events')\n    .description('Prepare events data by merging and validating')\n    .action(async () =\u003e         "contents": "async function importEventsData(force: boolean = false, update: boolean = false): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== UFO Intelligence Data Import ==='));\n  \n  // Check if events.json exists\n  const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n  const dataImportDir = path.join(projectDir, 'scripts/data-import');\n  const eventsJsonPath = path.join(dataImportDir, 'output/events.json');\n  \n  if (!fs.existsSync(eventsJsonPath)) {\n    console.log(chalk.red('Error: events.json not found. Please prepare the data first.'));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 1: Validating events data...'));\n  \n  // Run validation/test first\n  const validationResult = await testEventsImport();\n  \n  if (!validationResult) {\n    console.log(chalk.red('Validation failed. Fix issues before proceeding.'));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  // If force and update are not set via flags, prompt for them\n  if (!force || !update) {\n    const answers = await inquirer.prompt([\n      {\n        type: 'confirm',\n        name: 'confirmImport',\n        message: 'Would you like to proceed with the import?',\n        default: true\n      }\n    ]);\n    \n    if (!answers.confirmImport) {\n      console.log(chalk.yellow('Import cancelled.'));\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    if (!force) {\n      const { forceOption } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'confirm',\n          name: 'forceOption',\n          message: 'Force import even if duplicates are detected?',\n          default: false\n        }\n      ]);\n      force = forceOption;\n    }\n    \n    if (!update) {\n      const { updateOption } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'confirm',\n          name: 'updateOption',\n          message: 'Update existing records if duplicates are found?',\n          default: false\n        }\n      ]);\n      update = updateOption;\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Build command arguments\n  const args = [];\n  if (force) args.push('--force');\n  if (update) args.push('--update');\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 3: Importing events data to Xata database...'));\n  \n  const spinner = ora('Running TypeScript import script...').start();\n  \n",

        "contents": "  try {\n    // Run TypeScript import script with Bun\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 bun run ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/import-events-to-xata.ts')} ${args.join(' ')}&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Events import process complete');\n    \n    // Check if skipped events report exists\n    const skippedEventsReportPath = path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/skipped-events-report.json');\n    if (fs.existsSync(skippedEventsReportPath)) {\n      console.log(chalk.yellow(&#96;Skipped events report available at: ${skippedEventsReportPath}&#96;));\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to import events data to Xata: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Import sightings data\n */\nasync function importSightingsData(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== UFO Sightings Data Import ==='));\n  \n  // Check if sightings data exists\n  const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n  const sightingsFile = path.join(projectDir, 'output/transformed-sightings.json');\n  \n  if (!fs.existsSync(sightingsFile)) {\n    console.log(chalk.red(&#96;Error: Sightings data file not found at ${sightingsFile}&#96;));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 1: Sightings data found.'));\n  console.log(chalk.blue(&#96;  - JSON data: ${sightingsFile}&#96;));\n  \n  const { reviewData } = await inquirer.prompt([\n    {\n      type: 'confirm',\n      name: 'reviewData',\n      message: 'Would you like to review the sightings data before importing to Xata?',\n      default: false\n    }\n  ]);\n  \n",

        "originalContents": "  try {\n    // Run TypeScript import script with Bun\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 bun run ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/import-events-to-xata.ts')} ${args.join(' ')}&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Events import process complete');\n    \n    // Check if skipped events report exists\n    const skippedEventsReportPath = path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/skipped-events-report.json');\n    if (fs.existsSync(skippedEventsReportPath)) {\n      console.log(chalk.yellow(&#96;Skipped events report available at: ${skippedEventsReportPath}&#96;));\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to import events data to Xata: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Import sightings data\n */\nasync function importSightingsData(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== UFO Sightings Data Import ==='));\n  \n  // Check if sightings data exists\n  const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n  const sightingsFile = path.join(projectDir, 'output/transformed-sightings.json');\n  \n  if (!fs.existsSync(sightingsFile)) {\n    console.log(chalk.red(&#96;Error: Sightings data file not found at ${sightingsFile}&#96;));\n    return false;\n  }\n  \n  console.log(chalk.blue('Step 1: Sightings data found.'));\n  console.log(chalk.blue(&#96;  - JSON data: ${sightingsFile}&#96;));\n  \n  const { reviewData } = await inquirer.prompt([\n    {\n      type: 'confirm',\n      name: 'reviewData',\n      message: 'Would you like to review the sightings data before importing to Xata?',\n      default: false\n    }\n  ]);\n  \n",
```

```json
        "contents": "export default function registerImportCommands(program: Command): void {\n  // Main import command with interactive workflow\n  program\n    .command('import')\n    .description('Interactive data import workflow')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      const choices = [\n        { name: 'Prepare events data (merge and validate)', value: 'prepare-events' },\n        { name: 'Test events import (validate against database schema)', value: 'test-events' },\n        { name: 'Import events data to Xata', value: 'import-events' },\n        { name: 'Full workflow const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([\n        {\n          type: 'list',\n          name: 'action',\n          message: 'Select an import operation:',\n          choices\n        }\n      ]);\n\n      switch (action) {\n        case 'prepare-events':\n          await prepareEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'test-events':\n          await testEventsImport();\n          break;\n        case 'import-events':\n          await importEventsData();\n          break;\n        case 'full-workflow':\n          await runFullWorkflow();\n          break;\n        case 'import-sightings':\n          await importSightingsData();\n          break;\n        case 'back':\n          console.log(chalk.blue('Returning to main menu'));\n          break;\n      }\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for preparing events data\n  program\n    .command('import:prepare-events')\n    .description('Prepare events data by merging and validating')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await prepareEventsData();\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for testing events import\n  program\n    .command('import:test-events')\n    .description('Test events import by validating against         "originalContents": "5. **runFullWorkflow()**\n   - Orchestrate the full prepare -\u003e test -\u003e import process\n\n### 4. Integration with Main CLI\n\nUpdate &#96;bin/cli.ts&#96; to include the new import commands:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ntry {\n  const registerProcessingCommands = require('../src/commands/processing').default;\n  const registerReviewCommands = require('../src/commands/review').default;\n  const registerInsertionCommands = require('../src/commands/insertion').default;\n  const registerImportCommands = require('../src/commands/import').default; // Add this line\n\n  // Register commands with the program\n  registerProcessingCommands(program);\n  registerReviewCommands(program);\n  registerInsertionCommands(program);\n  registerImportCommands(program); // Add this line\n  \n  // Display help if no arguments provided\n  if (process.argv.length === 2) {\n    program.help();\n  }\n\n  // Parse command line arguments\n  program.parse(process.argv);\n} catch (error) {\n  console.error(chalk.red('Error initializing CLI commands:'), error);\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Full Implementation Detail\n\n### import.ts Module\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/commands/import.ts\nimport { Command } from 'commander';\nimport chalk from 'chalk';\nimport * as inquirer from 'inquirer';\nimport ora from 'ora';\nimport * as path from 'path';\nimport * as fs from 'fs';\nimport { exec } from 'child_process';\nimport { promisify } from 'util';\n\nconst execAsync = promisify(exec);\n\n/**\n * Register import commands with Commander\n * @param program The Commander program instance\n */\n",

        "contents": "program\n  .name('data-import-cli')\n  .description('CLI tool for processing and inserting UFO data into Xata')\n  .version('1.0.0');\n\n// Register subcommands\nprocessingCmd(program);\nreviewCmd(program);\ninsertionCmd(program);\n\nprogram.parse(process.argv);\n\nSubcommand Examples\n\t1.\tProcessing Commands\n\t•\tprocess:list – Lists all files in the processing bucket.\n\t•\tprocess:transform \u003cfile\u003e – Runs a transformation on the selected file.\n\t•\tprocess:enhance \u003cfile\u003e – Optionally run the AI assistant to analyze/enhance the file.\n\t2.\tReview Commands\n\t•\treview:list – Lists files ready for review.\n\t•\treview:preview \u003cfile\u003e – Displays a preview.\n\t•\treview:approve \u003cfile\u003e – Moves the file to the insertion bucket along with creating/updating the metadata.\n\t•\treview:reject \u003cfile\u003e – Option to reject file processing.\n\t3.\tInsertion Commands\n\t•\tinsert:list – View files in the insertion bucket with metadata summary.\n\t•\tinsert:batch \u003cfile\u003e [options] – Perform batch insertion with options for batch interval, preview step, etc.\n\t•\tinsert:bulk \u003cfile\u003e – Perform bulk insertion into the specified Xata table.\n\nNote: Use inquirer to provide interactive menus. For instance, when listing files, present checkboxes or lists for file selection.\n\n⸻\n\n4. Component-Level Detail\n\n4.1. File Management (fileManager.js)\n\t•\tResponsibility:\n\t•\tScanning directories (processing vs. insertion).\n\t•\tMoving files (after review, move from processing to insertion).\n\t•\tReading and writing metadata alongside each file.\n\t•\tImplementation Ideas:\n\t•\tUse Node’s fs module along with path for robust file operations.\n\t•\tImplement helper methods like listFiles(directory), moveFile(src, dest), and readMetadata(file).\n\n",

            "text": "Subcommand Examples"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104,
            "text": "\t1.\tProcessing Commands"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 105,
            "text": "\t•\tprocess:list – Lists all files in the processing bucket."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 106,
            "text": "\t•\tprocess:transform \u003cfile\u003e – Runs a transformation on the selected file."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 107,
            "text": "\t•\tprocess:enhance \u003cfile\u003e – Optionally run the AI assistant to analyze/enhance the file."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 108,
            "text": "\t2.\tReview Commands"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 109,
            "text": "\t•\treview:list – Lists files ready for review."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 110,
            "text": "\t•\treview:preview \u003cfile\u003e – Displays a preview."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 111,
            "text": "\t•\treview:approve \u003cfile\u003e – Moves the file to the insertion bucket along with creating/updating the metadata."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 112,
            "text": "\t•\treview:reject \u003cfile\u003e – Option to reject file processing."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 113,
            "text": "\t3.\tInsertion Commands"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 114,
            "text": "\t•\tinsert:list – View files in the insertion bucket with metadata summary."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 115,
            "text": "\t•\tinsert:batch \u003cfile\u003e [options] – Perform batch insertion with options for batch interval, preview step, etc."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 116,
            "text": "\t•\tinsert:bulk \u003cfile\u003e – Perform bulk insertion into the specified Xata table."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118,
            "text": "Note: Use inquirer to provide interactive menus. For instance, when listing files, present checkboxes or lists for file selection."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120,
            "text": "⸻"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122,
            "text": "4. Component-Level Detail"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 124,
            "text": "4.1. File Management (fileManager.js)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 125,
            "text": "\t•\tResponsibility:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126,
            "text": "\t•\tScanning directories (processing vs. insertion)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 127,
            "text": "\t•\tMoving files (after review, move from processing to insertion)."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128,
            "text": "\t•\tReading and writing metadata alongside each file."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 129,
            "text": "\t•\tImplementation Ideas:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130,
            "text": "\t•\tUse Node’s fs module along with path for robust file operations."
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131,
            "text": "\t•\tImplement helper methods like listFiles(directory), moveFile(src, dest), and readMetadata(file)."
          },

        "originalContents": "program\n  .name('data-import-cli')\n  .description('CLI tool for processing and inserting UFO data into Xata')\n  .version('1.0.0');\n\n// Register subcommands\nprocessingCmd(program);\nreviewCmd(program);\ninsertionCmd(program);\n\nprogram.parse(process.argv);\n\nSubcommand Examples\n\t1.\tProcessing Commands\n\t•\tprocess:list – Lists all files in the processing bucket.\n\t•\tprocess:transform \u003cfile\u003e – Runs a transformation on the selected file.\n\t•\tprocess:enhance \u003cfile\u003e – Optionally run the AI assistant to analyze/enhance the file.\n\t2.\tReview Commands\n\t•\treview:list – Lists files ready for review.\n\t•\treview:preview \u003cfile\u003e – Displays a preview.\n\t•\treview:approve \u003cfile\u003e – Moves the file to the insertion bucket along with creating/updating the metadata.\n\t•\treview:reject \u003cfile\u003e – Option to reject file processing.\n\t3.\tInsertion Commands\n\t•\tinsert:list – View files in the insertion bucket with metadata summary.\n\t•\tinsert:batch \u003cfile\u003e [options] – Perform batch insertion with options for batch interval, preview step, etc.\n\t•\tinsert:bulk \u003cfile\u003e – Perform bulk insertion into the specified Xata table.\n\nNote: Use inquirer to provide interactive menus. For instance, when listing files, present checkboxes or lists for file selection.\n\n⸻\n\n4. Component-Level Detail\n\n4.1. File Management (fileManager.js)\n\t•\tResponsibility:\n\t•\tScanning directories (processing vs. insertion).\n\t•\tMoving files (after review, move from processing to insertion).\n\t•\tReading and writing metadata alongside each file.\n\t•\tImplementation Ideas:\n\t•\tUse Node’s fs module along with path for robust file operations.\n\t•\tImplement helper methods like listFiles(directory), moveFile(src, dest), and readMetadata(file).\n\n",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "  program\n    .command('import:events')\n    .description('Import events data to Xata')\n    .option('-f, --force', 'Force import even if duplicates are detected')\n    .option('-u, --update', 'Update existing records if duplicates are found')\n    .action(async (options) =\u003e {\n      await importEventsData(options.force, options.update);\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for importing sightings data\n  program\n    .command('import:sightings')\n    .description('Import UFO Sightings data')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await importSightingsData();\n    });\n}\n\n/**\n * Prepare events data\n */\nasync function prepareEventsData(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== Preparing Events Data ==='));\n  \n  const spinner = ora('Processing JSON event files...').start();\n  \n  try {\n    const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n    const dataImportDir = path.join(projectDir, 'scripts/data-import');\n    \n    // Execute the preparation script\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 bun run ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/prepare-events.ts')}&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Events preparation complete');\n    console.log(chalk.green(&#96;Combined events file saved to: ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'output/events.json')}&#96;));\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to prepare events data: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Test events import\n */\n",

        "originalContents": "  program\n    .command('import:events')\n    .description('Import events data to Xata')\n    .option('-f, --force', 'Force import even if duplicates are detected')\n    .option('-u, --update', 'Update existing records if duplicates are found')\n    .action(async (options) =\u003e {\n      await importEventsData(options.force, options.update);\n    });\n\n  // Direct command for importing sightings data\n  program\n    .command('import:sightings')\n    .description('Import UFO Sightings data')\n    .action(async () =\u003e {\n      await importSightingsData();\n    });\n}\n\n/**\n * Prepare events data\n */\nasync function prepareEventsData(): Promise\u003cboolean\u003e {\n  console.log(chalk.blue('=== Preparing Events Data ==='));\n  \n  const spinner = ora('Processing JSON event files...').start();\n  \n  try {\n    const projectDir = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../..');\n    const dataImportDir = path.join(projectDir, 'scripts/data-import');\n    \n    // Execute the preparation script\n    await execAsync(&#96;cd ${projectDir} \u0026\u0026 bun run ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'events/prepare-events.ts')}&#96;);\n    \n    spinner.succeed('Events preparation complete');\n    console.log(chalk.green(&#96;Combined events file saved to: ${path.join(dataImportDir, 'output/events.json')}&#96;));\n    \n    return true;\n  } catch (error) {\n    spinner.fail(&#96;Error: Failed to prepare events data: ${(error as Error).message}&#96;);\n    return false;\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Test events import\n */\n",
```
